steps.q: Does it make a great product or service?

views.text: In July 2023, Equity Mates recounted a low-range Kogan TV purchase where the screen size and picture were fine but speaker quality was poor, showing mixed product quality at cheaper price points.

episode.title: Cost of Living: How can we save money on household equipment

views.text: In May 2023, Equity Mates outlined Kogan Mobile's 365-day plan at $199 upfront for unlimited calls and texts and 500 GB of data, noting it used the Telstra network and worked out to about $16 a month, with frequent marketing emails mentioned.

episode.title: 5 Budget-Friendly Ideas for Reducing Your Cost of Living

views.text: In September 2021, a guest on Equity Mates described Kogan.com as an e-commerce company focused on making in-demand products and services more affordable across many categories.

episode.title: CEO: Ruslan Kogan - Growing From $0 to $1b in Annual Sales | Kogan.com

steps.q: Will it keep earning above market profits?

views.text: In March 2024, Equity Mates reported Roy Morgan estimated TEMU had over 1.26 million Australian shoppers and $1.31 billion in sales, and was fast closing on Kogan, highlighting intensifying competition from Chinese platforms.

episode.title: Top 5 ASX stocks of the past 10 years, TikTok, Temu & Shein make news & a crypto market update

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates said Kogan’s revenue fell 8%, it recorded a $35 million loss versus a $3 million profit the year prior, and margins were pressured by excess inventory.

episode.title: Disney is getting into sports betting + Earnings wrap

views.text: In March 2022, Equity Mates noted Morningstar labelled Kogan as "no moat" in its write-up, raising questions about durable competitive advantages even as it provided a fair value estimate to subscribers.

views.text: In August 2022, Equity Mates highlighted Kogan’s share price jumping about 67% from a mid-July low before falling 22%, illustrating volatile market expectations around its earnings and outlook.

views.text: In March 2022, Equity Mates listed Kogan among Morningstar’s 13 Australian stocks trading at what it considered significant discounts to fair value, noting its share price had fallen 57 percent over 12 months and that uncertainty remained high.
